title: Ancillary dwelling: maximum one per site and maximum internal floor area per Table 2.8a
text: C2.8.1 An ancillary dwelling in accordance with Table 2.8a, provided that it: i. does not preclude the primary dwelling from meeting the maximum site cover and the minimum required private open space, soft landscaping, trees and deep soil area; and ii. complies with the following design elements as relevant: 2.2 Solar access and natural ventilation; 2.3 Parking; 2.5 Utilities; 3.1 Site cover; 3.2 Building height; 3.3 Street setbacks; 3.4 Lot boundary setbacks; 3.5 Site works and retaining walls; 3.6 Streetscape; 3.7 Access; 3.9 Solar access for adjoining sites; 3.10 Visual privacy. Table 2.8a Ancillary dwelling provisions: When provided on the same site as a Small Dwelling in accordance with C2.9.1 - maximum ancillary dwellings 1 per site, maximum internal floor area 70m2; All other primary dwellings - maximum ancillary dwellings 1 per site, maximum internal floor area 90m2.

replaces.note: 70m2 -> 90m2; 70m2 retained where on the same site as a small dwelling
explicit 'behind the street setback line' dropped (register ch2-033)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Conditions (i) (primary dwelling still meets site cover, POS, soft landscaping, trees, deep soil) and (ii) (compliance with elements 2.2, 2.3, 2.5, 3.1-3.7, 3.9, 3.10 as relevant) are cross-references tested by those rules on the combined development, not here. Table note: provisions relate to the ancillary portion except 3.1 site cover, 3.4 lot boundary setbacks and 3.9 solar access, assessed in combination with the primary dwelling. Register ch2-033: ancillary dwellings now must comply with 3.6 streetscape (Part B exempted street surveillance), and element 2.2 is listed (R50+ orientation). Register ch2-032: Info Sheet 3 says LGs may allow more than 90m2 by LPP without WAPC approval, but Ch1 Table 2.5A shows WAPC approval; inconsistency to clarify.
